notes.title: 📢 DreamWorld Patch Notes 📢 - 03/17
notes.content:
Hey Dreamers, happy St. Patricks Day! ☘️

We've been working on a wide variety of improvements and projects that we wanted to share before diving into some of our large items coming up! Check out what's new:


💃 Character Improvements


 New Sprint Animation - Fixed a creak in the Elysian's back!
 Mob Movement Polish - Navigation, perception, and spawning have all been improved.


💕 Social Features 


 Reliquary Permissions Tab - Allows for fine control over actions within your bases!
 Social Hud Bug Fixes - Your friends will stay friends! And more accurate statuses...


⛰️ Spawning


 GigaBiome added back - Consult the welcoming center for more details
 Gravel liberally added to tunnels.


🛠️ General Improvements


 Fixed drop rates - Flower sap, fish from, kelp, and flowers have all been adjusted.
 Improved many sounds and general sound QOL 🔊
 Fixed farming growing and showing issues to other players.
 Many UI improvements, especially controller related.
 Mount camera reverted - Ride On! 🐎

notes.title: 📢 DreamWorld Patch Notes 📢– 02/20
notes.content:
Hey Dreamers! 🌙✨
We've been hard at work making DreamWorld even better based on your feedback! This update brings performance optimizations, UI improvements, controller support, and major system upgrades. Check out what's new:

🛠️ General Improvements & Fixes


Tutorial Enhancements – Streamlined for a smoother experience!
New Falling Intro Sequence – More immersive landing into DreamWorld.
Music & Sound Upgrades – Improved tracks and sound effects for better immersion.
UI & HUD Updates – Enhanced visuals, improved social & reliquary HUDs.
City Optimization – Improved frame rates in larger hubs.
Area Protector System Refactored – Bug fixes & performance tweaks.
Bug Fixes! 🛠️ Countless small fixes to improve stability and gameplay.


⚔️ Mob & Combat Refactor


Improved replication performance for smoother interactions.
World destruction enhancements.
Refined combat logic for better responsiveness.


🎮 Controller Support & Enhanced Input


Full controller support added!
Improved UI icons & input feedback to enhance usability.


🎨 UI/UX Improvements


Shift-click support for faster interactions.
Reliquary & Social HUD updates for better visibility.


🔧 Additional Changes


Secondary Drop System Updated – Better item distribution.
NPC Behavior Improvements – Still a work in progress but significantly better!
Falling Intro Sequence Tweaks – More immersive, but still being improved.


This update sets the stage for even bigger improvements coming soon! Let us know what you think and keep sharing your feedback. See you in DreamWorld!

notes.title: 🚀 Sneak Peek: What’s Coming in Dream World’s Next Update!
notes.content:
Hey Dream World adventurers! 🌟

Our next big update is just around the corner, and while we’re still making final adjustments, we wanted to give you a glimpse of what’s coming. This isn’t the full patch list—expect official patch notes closer to launch—but here are some key highlights to get excited about!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45126151/db49e73e9f3c4cf8b0bb15d1dfd53e4e00aa6975.png

🔥 What’s in Development?
🏹 Mob Refactor – Smarter Enemies & Better Combat
We’re continuing to refine enemy behavior, making combat more dynamic, responsive, and strategic.

✅ Improved combat logic – Enemies will move and attack more intelligently.
✅ Better world destruction mechanics – Environments react more realistically during battles.
✅ Multiplayer replication improvements – Smoother AI behavior in co-op play.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45126151/0cab4b469e3f56368d3858c58abb577e635d8eba.png

🎮 Confirmed: Full Controller Support!
We’re happy to confirm that full controller support is coming in this update! Gamepad players will enjoy seamless input, improved UI navigation, and better responsiveness.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45126151/26090dcb527808757fc75c947d36ab9b2b528731.gif

🏙 Performance Optimizations & Area Protection Fixes
This update also includes major performance improvements, especially for large cities and multiplayer environments.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45126151/541066b5a192edd3b928eba06b079b7e0b7ebb88.png

✅ City performance optimizations – Faster load times & improved FPS.
✅ Area Protector System Fixes – Bug fixes and general stability improvements.
✅ Secondary Drop System Tweaks – More balanced and dynamic loot distribution.

📌 Until then, make sure to follow and wishlist DreamWorld so you don’t miss anything!

notes.title: Important Update on the DreamWorld Playtest 🎮
notes.content:
Hey Dreamers! 🎮

The DreamWorld Playtest is nearing its next big milestone! Starting Monday, December 2nd, we’ll no longer allow new players to join the playtest. If you haven’t already, download the game on Steam and log in before then!

For players who created an account prior to December 2nd, you’ll still have access to the game until we prepare for our next major release. Don’t worry—your builds, resources, and items will carry over to future versions of DreamWorld!

As part of this transition, the current playtest will be removed from Steam libraries ahead of our 2025 DreamWorld release. To ensure you don’t miss out, make sure to “ADD TO YOUR WISHLIST” and “FOLLOW” our Steam Page

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45210421/48f6264422194034dfb4499f2695465c33c50395.png

Don’t forget—our Refer a Friend Program is also ending on December 2nd, so invite your friends and earn rewards while you still can. After that date, new players will need a Steam Key to join. Learn more

Have questions? Reach out to us anytime on Discord ou email us support@playdreamworld.com 

Thank you for helping make DreamWorld amazing! ❤️

notes.title: 📢 DreamWorld Patch Notes - 10/31/2024 📢
notes.content:
✨ Improvements:

Enhanced lighting and ambiance to create a more immersive world.
Updated tutorial flow with improved instructions and text for a smoother onboarding experience.
Adjusted smelting options according to furnace tier, optimizing crafting efficiency.
Improved collision generation for certain destructible objects, reducing lag and enhancing performance.
Refined tool meshes and materials for a more polished look.
Improved reliquary location checks to handle irregular shapes more effectively.
Updated UI for reliquaries, stats, and skills panels.
Added a pulse effect to highlight overlapping limited assets for better placement guidance.
Enhanced digging logic, making it easier to level up with better tools.
Improved recipe balance and adjusted several crafting requirements.


🐞 Bug Fixes:

Fixed resource loss issue when crafting and cancelling smelting.
Resolved resource issues related to placing, moving, and upgrading various assets.
Corrected issues with destroying smelters and cooking stations while in use.
Fixed mob aggro range and chase radius; reintroduced mob "home" logic.
Prevented friends from opening chests inside owner's reliquaries.
Generated assets can now be trashed, allowing for additional generations.
Improved chest behavior to prevent item overflow when inventory is full.
Fixed night mob behavior and enhanced its underlying logic.
Improved tutorial text, icons, and descriptions across multiple areas.

notes.title: DreamWorld Referral Program – Invite Friends & Earn Rewards! 🎁
notes.content:
Dear Dreamers!

We’re thrilled to introduce the DreamWorld Referral Program, where you can earn rewards by inviting friends to play DreamWorld! 

Here’s how it works:

[olist]
 Sign up on Gleam
Visit our Gleam page here and sign up using your email. Connect your Steam account to activate the referral tracking system.
 Play DreamWorld on Steam:
If you haven’t already, request access to play DreamWorld on Steam and dive into the infinite world of adventure. This step is required to unlock your referral link.
 Generate Your Referral Link:
Once you’ve connected your Steam account, click on the “Refer Friends” button on the Gleam page. You’ll receive a unique referral link that you can start sharing immediately.
 Share Your Link Everywhere:
Post your link on social media, share it in gaming groups, or send it directly to friends. The more you share, the more chances you have to earn points!
 Earn Points for Successful Referrals:
For every friend who signs up using your link and plays at least once, you’ll earn +10 points. Remember, your friend must play at least once for the referral to count.
 Redeem Your Rewards:
For every 100 points (equivalent to 10 successful referrals), you’ll receive a $10 Amazon gift card! Points are automatically tracked, and rewards are sent to the email you registered with Gleam every Friday.
[/olist]

This Event runs until November 15th.

Want to learn more about how to maximize your rewards? Read the full blog post here!

Every referral counts! If you have any questions, feel free to reach out on Discord or email support@playdreamworld.com

Stay awesome, keep dreaming, and see you online! 🪐✨
